retrievalProfile.description: A vibrant, painterly animal silhouette set against a flat color field with a textured border and hand-drawn, shadowed typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A profile view of a bison rendered in a chaotic, multi-colored expressionist painting style, centered within a blue rectangular frame that is itself surrounded by a textured orange border. The composition is anchored by hand-drawn, drop-shadowed text at the top and bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast color blocking between the orange border and blue inner field
Textural contrast between the flat blue background and the impasto-style bison
Symmetrical framing of the subject by top and bottom typography
Grounding of the subject on a dark, horizontal base line
coreInvariants: Multi-colored, non-naturalistic palette within the animal's form
Heavy black drop shadow on all text elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central bison profile occupying 60% of the inner blue frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bison's head and front shoulder, where the brightest yellow and orange highlights are concentrated.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top display text, move down to the bison's head, follow the body to the right, and drop to the bottom script.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample blue space around the bison to allow the complex textures to breathe.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Periwinkle blue (inner field) and warm orange (outer border).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep navy and black for shadows and grounding.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Magenta, yellow, and teal within the bison's coat.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the border and subject highlights; medium value in the background to make the subject pop.

letterConstructionRules: Irregular stroke widths suggesting a brush or marker
Heavy, offset black drop shadow to the bottom-right
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'y' and 'g' with long, expressive descenders
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A blocky, all-caps header paired with a more fluid, rhythmic script footer.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the top header's organic but bold presence
Mimics the bottom text's fluid, handwritten quality

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an expressionist oil painting of a bison in profile with vibrant, non-naturalistic colors (magenta, yellow, teal) on a flat periwinkle blue background. Surround the blue field with a thick, textured orange border that looks like sponge painting. Include a dark, rough horizontal line at the bottom for the bison to stand on.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add hand-drawn cream-colored text with a heavy black drop shadow. Place all-caps blocky text at the top and a more fluid script at the bottom, ensuring the lettering looks organic and slightly irregular.

verificationChecks: Is the bison multi-colored and painterly?
Is there a distinct orange border around a blue field?
Does the text have a thick black drop shadow?
Is the typography hand-drawn in style?

adjustableVariables: Color palette of the animal's coat
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the bison's colors don't blend too much into the blue background.
Check that the text is legible despite the hand-drawn style.
Verify the orange border has a tactile, sponge-like texture.
Confirm the drop shadow is dark and consistent across all letters.
recipe.reuseFormula: Expressionist Animal + Color Blocked Frame + Hand-Drawn Shadowed Type
